keptScripts.reason: Spawns a full Storybook vitest browser run (measurement, not a gate); unchanged. Its reporter scripts/a11y-baseline-reporter.mjs is kept.

notes: Rules added: data-slot, use-client-source, component-registration (was components:check), variant-coverage, state-coverage, loading-states, viewer-highlight, a11y-baseline, agent-output-contract (restored from 2fa2ce6; never had npm scripts). The old a11y:baseline:check --update WRITER moved to scripts/a11y-baseline-update.mjs (--prune kept); reporter + writer unit tests moved to scripts/a11y-baseline-reporter.test.mjs — please add the two addScripts and run the test in the selftests battery. RUNNER CORE (additive, covered in run.test.mjs, documented in README): (1) baseline.mjs — a per-file finding may carry an integer `weight` (default 1, may be 0/negative); a file's count = sum of weights. Needed because data-slot's old [components, slots] pair ratchet is only expressible monotonically as the signed per-module gap components − slots (non-negative counts cannot track it). per-file `count` is now the weight sum (identical for unweighted rules). (2) run.mjs checkFixtures — a fixture may carry an optional `baseline`; pass/fail is judged with evaluate() against it (empty baseline = previous semantics: pass ⇔ 0 findings). data-slot semantics change: fails whenever components − slots rises, which is the old gate's failure set PLUS 'added N parts with fewer than N new slots' (the documented hole the old gate let pass). component-registration: baseline ratcheted 5 → 4 (nav-notifications now has stories, the old gate's advisory); its orphan advisory reads the committed brand-ui.manifest.json instead of calling packages/cli generateManifest in-process.
